title: Page 2
content_zh:
“什么事情？”他震惊到还无法完全回过神来，恐怕短时间内暂时是无法接受这样的事实。
“就是，我要代替大哥活下去，大哥能做的事情，我也可以做，而且绝对不会比大哥差！”她斗志异常高昂地宣布。“无烟哥，之前布庄的图稿是大哥提供给你的吧，你尽管放心，我会代替大哥，继续提供图稿给你，你不必担心得重新寻找画师，只要有我在，一切都会没问题的！”
“昭颖，你不必勉强……”他不得不担心，她该不会是因为昭旭的死受到太大刺激，才会变成这样吧？“一点都不勉强，相信我，我一定会证明给你看的！”梁昭颖完全不理会他的劝慰，信誓旦旦地说道。
她性子变了，原本的文静内敛及顺从不见了，取而代之的是像男孩子般豪气不服输的个性，像是彻底换了个人似的。
戚无烟无言以对，不知道该和这个性情大变的小姑娘说些什么，倒是很想把好友从地底下给挖出来，揪住他的衣领质问一一昭旭，你到底丢了什么样的麻烦给我，我现在还可以反悔吗？
第1章(1)
戚家，京城内数一数二的富商，从事茶楼、镳局、布庄、钱庄四种买卖，各由戚家四位公子掌管打理，可以说是无人不知、无人不晓，在商界内的势力可是大得吓人。
戚家的产业之一“无戚布庄”就座落在京城最热闹的街道上，人来人往，生意兴隆，不过只要仔细一瞧就会发现，布庄的客人有半数是年轻的姑娘家，而这些姑娘其实醉翁之意不在“布”，而是布庄的主事者一一戚无烟。
无戚布庄门前停下一辆马车，众女瞩目的戚无烟从容优雅地从马车上走下来，他那一身天蓝色的招牌身影一翩然落地，就好像仙人下凡似的飘逸出尘，顿时让众家姑娘惊叹连连，立刻被他的气质所迷倒。
“是二公子，难得有机会遇到他耶……”
戚无烟还没来得及走进布庄里，就在门前被众多爱慕者给围起来，简直是寸步难行，不过他早已经习惯这样子的混乱，还是一副气定神闲的淡然模样，不被混乱所影响。
他扬起一抹淡淡的笑，以低沈醇厚的嗓音说：“不好意思，可以让一条路出来让我进布庄吗？”
“当然、当然，我们这就让路！”果然戚无烟亲自开口，姑娘们很快地就退出一条路，让她们仰慕的对象能够顺利进到布庄里。
“多谢各位姑娘。”他继续保持淡笑，终于可以顺利进到布庄里。
没想到在这个节骨眼上，某个留着八字胡的中年男子却从众家姑娘外围硬是突围挤入，气急败坏地大喊道：“戚无烟，你给我站住！”
“呃？”戚无烟纳闷地一顿。“你哪位？我们认识吗？”
“你连我也不认识？”这下子中年男子更是气得想跳脚了。“我就是对面吕记布庄的吕得泰，我都搬来一年了，你不要告诉我你从没见过我！”
“喔……”不重要，难怪没印象。
吕得泰火气十足地对他呛话。“戚无烟，有本事你就堂堂正正地做生意，和我一较高下，别总是用‘卖弄美色’这一招，你不觉得丢脸，我都替你感到丢脸！”
吕得泰本来是京城第一的大布商，可以说是呼风唤雨，威风得很，但自从无戚布庄出现之后，他的声势就一落千丈，连生意也是直直落，再也不复从前荣景。

他很不甘心，所以一逮到机会，他就买下无戚布庄对面空下来的房子，将自己的吕记布庄迁过来，故意来抢生意，绝不让无戚布庄再继续壮大下去。
“我卖弄美色？如果布庄因此而生意好，那也没什么损失，我也不会少一块肉。”戚无烟挑了挑眉，懒得理这种无聊的挑衅话语，转身走进布庄。
色不迷人人自迷，他可没有存心拿这张脸蛋来魅惑他人，如果她们主动因为他的美色而心甘情愿花钱买布，那也是她们自愿的，关他什么事？“什么？你……”
“喂，你不要嫉妒二公子长得好看就酸他，是你自己没本事，快回去吧！”
众家娘子军同时发威，将恶意亵渎她们心目中完美谪仙的吕得泰给狠狠地挤出人群外，害他狼狈地一屁股坐倒在大街上，让众人看了一个大笑话。
但谁理他，姑娘们当然是尾随着戚无烟赶紧进到无戚布庄里，就算碰不到他的人，远远看着也好呀！
“二公子，你觉得我适合穿什么颜色的衣裳？我拿不定主意，你可以帮我看一看吗……”
面对众家姑娘明显意图不良的殷勤，戚无烟总是以不变应万变，不着痕迹地避开她们有意无意的靠近，非常巧妙地和她们保持距离。
说实话，他不怎么喜欢她们总是想往他的身上黏，好像他是一块上好的肥肉一样，但看在她们都是客人的分上，他也不想跟她们多加计较，能避就尽量避开。
现在他只想赶快走上布庄二楼的厢房里，将这些麻烦女人丢给吴掌柜和伙计们应付，他对她们的忍耐度有限，要是再被痴缠下去，他可是会……
“二公子小心！”
说时迟那时快，一个体型臃肿的胖姑娘瞬间突破重围，假装脚滑就要朝戚无烟扑了过去，这一扑下去可不得了，不被压死也会去掉半条命呀！
戚无烟一个利落转身，优雅地避过胖姑娘的袭击，紧接着他有些微恼的皱起眉，一振衣袖，适时地将快扑倒的她给推回去，然后她再顺了那股力量回了三圈，就这样莫名其妙地站稳脚步，重新抓回重心，让所有人看得是啧啧称奇。
胖姑娘不敢置信，傻愣在当场，根本搞不清楚刚才到底发生了什么事情，她原本是想乘机扑倒戚无烟，好大吃他一顿豆腐的，怎么……怎么却会变成现在这个样子？“哇哈哈……好精彩，刚才那个旋转可以媲美胡旋舞呀，噗哈哈哈……实在是太有趣了……”
庄内众人有志一同地全朝门口狂笑的女声望过去，见到一个男人打扮的姑娘无所节制地狂笑，大家顿时倒抽了口气，有些人是一脸嫌恶，更多的是一脸害怕，好像碰到她就会染上什么可怕的瘟疫一样。
“是梁升粮行的梁昭颖！”
戚无烟原本有些不耐烦的眼神突然一亮，赶紧也往门口的方向望过去，态度明显地改变。
别的女人他连理都懒得理，但昭颖可不同于其它女人，在他心中有着特别的地位，对她的关注当然也非比寻常。
说到梁昭颖，在京城里和戚无烟一样，可以说是无人不知无人不晓，但她让众人印象深刻的原因不是她的容貌，而是她那有些疯癫的言行举止。
大家都在传，她一定是中了什么邪，才会在三年前她哥哥梁昭旭死后突然之间性情大变，变成现在这副不男不女的模样，也因此没人想上梁家提亲，将她给娶过门去，而她也早已过了适婚年龄，是个二十一岁的老姑娘了。

不过面对外界对她的闲言闲语，她一概不想理会，男装照扮，从母亲手中扛下梁升粮行的经营买卖，早已不把自己当女人看待了。
梁昭颖一走进布庄，靠她最近的姑娘们就赶紧往两旁退，非常主动地让出一条路来，不想和她有任何碰触，就怕也会和她一样得疯病，而梁昭颖也早就习惯女人把她当成瘟神躲避的态度了，根本就不痛不痒。
content_en:
"What happened?" He was so shocked that he still couldn't fully recover. I'm afraid he wouldn't be able to accept this fact in a short time.
"That is, I want to live in my eldest brother's place. I can also do the things that my eldest brother can do, and I will definitely not be worse than him!" She declared with extremely high fighting spirit. "Brother Wuyan, the previous drawings of Buzhuang were provided to you by my eldest brother. Don't worry, I will continue to provide you with the drawings in my eldest brother's stead. You don't have to worry about finding a new painter. As long as I am here, everything will be fine!"
"Zhaoying, you don't have to force it..." He had to worry that she was so stimulated by Zhaoxu's death that she became like this? "Don't force it at all, believe me, I will definitely prove it to you!" Liang Zhaoying completely ignored his consolation and said confidently.
Her temperament changed, her original quiet, reserved and submissive personality was gone, replaced by a boy-like bold and unyielding personality, as if she had completely changed into a different person.
Qi Wuyan was speechless. He didn't know what to say to this little girl whose temperament had changed drastically. He really wanted to dig his friend out of the ground, grab him by the collar and ask Zhaoxu, what kind of trouble have you caused me? Can I still regret it now?
Chapter 1(1)
The Qi family, one of the most wealthy businessmen in the capital, is engaged in four types of businesses: teahouses, bureaus, cloth stores, and banks. Each of them is managed by the four sons of the Qi family. It can be said that everyone knows about it and its influence in the business world is terrifying.
One of the properties of the Qi family, "Wuqi Cloth Shop", is located on the busiest street in the capital. People come and go, and business is booming. However, if you take a closer look, you will find that half of the customers of the cloth shop are young girls. In fact, these girls are not interested in "cloth", but Qi Wuyan, the person in charge of the cloth shop.
A carriage stopped in front of Wuqi Cloth Village, and Qi Wuyan, who was attracting the attention of all the girls, stepped out of the carriage calmly and gracefully. As soon as his signature sky-blue figure landed on the ground, he was like an immortal descending from the earth. The girls were immediately amazed and were immediately fascinated by his temperament.
"He's the second young master. It's a rare chance to meet him..."
Before Qi Wuyan had time to enter the cloth shop, he was surrounded by many admirers in front of the door. It was difficult to move. However, he had long been accustomed to such chaos, and he still looked calm and indifferent, not affected by the chaos.
He raised a faint smile and said in a deep and mellow voice: "Excuse me, can you make a way for me to enter Buzhuang?"
"Of course, of course, let's get out of the way!" Sure enough, Qi Wuyan said it himself, and the girls quickly backed out of a road, allowing the object of their admiration to enter the cloth shop smoothly.
"Thank you girls." He continued to smile lightly and finally entered the cloth shop smoothly.
Unexpectedly, at this juncture, a middle-aged man with a mustache broke through the surrounding girls and squeezed in, shouting angrily: "Qi Wuyan, stop!"
"Huh?" Qi Wuyan paused in confusion. "Who are you? Do we know each other?"
"You don't even know me?" Now the middle-aged man was so angry that he wanted to jump. "I am Lu Detai from Luji Buzhuang across the street. I have moved here for a year. Don't tell me that you have never seen me!"
"Oh..." It's not important, no wonder I'm not impressed.
Lu Detai choked him angrily. "Qi Wuyan, if you have the ability, just do business openly and compete with me. Don't always use the trick of 'showing off your beauty'. If you don't feel embarrassed, I feel ashamed for you!"
Lu Detai was originally the number one cloth merchant in the capital, and he could be said to be a powerful and powerful man. However, since the emergence of Wuqi Cloth Village, his reputation has plummeted, and even his business has plummeted, and he has never been as prosperous as before.
He was very unwilling, so heWhen he got the opportunity, he bought the vacant house opposite Wuqi Boutique and moved his Luji Boutique here, deliberately grabbing business and never allowing Wuqi Boutique to continue to grow.
"Am I showing off my beauty? If Cloth Shop's business is good because of this, there will be no loss, and I won't lose a piece of meat." Qi Wuyan raised his eyebrows, not bothering to pay attention to such boring provocative words, and turned around and walked into Cloth Shop.
People are attracted to beauty if they are not attractive. He did not intentionally use this face to charm others. If they took the initiative to spend money to buy cloth because of his beauty, then it was their own volition. What did it have to do with him? "What? You..."
"Hey, don't be jealous of the second young master's good looks and hate him. It's because you don't have the ability. Go back quickly!"
All the women's troops showed their power at the same time, and violently squeezed Lu Detai out of the crowd, who maliciously blasphemed the perfect immortal in their minds, causing him to sit down on the street in a state of embarrassment, making everyone watch a big joke.
But no one paid attention to him. Of course the girls followed Qi Wuyan and hurried into Wuqi Cloth Village. Even if they couldn't meet him, they could just watch him from a distance!
"Second Young Master, what color clothes do you think are suitable for me? I can't make up my mind. Can you help me take a look..."
Faced with the obviously ill-intentioned solicitude from the girls, Qi Wuyan always remained unchanged in response to the ever-changing situation, avoiding their intentional or unintentional approach without leaving a trace, and keeping a distance from them very skillfully.
To be honest, he didn't really like that they always wanted to cling to him, as if he was a piece of fine fat, but since they were all guests, he didn't want to fuss with them, so he would try to avoid them if he could.
Now he just wants to hurry up to the wing on the second floor of Buzhuang and leave these troublesome women to Shopkeeper Wu and the guys. His tolerance for them is limited. If he is obsessed with them again, he will...
"Second Young Master, be careful!"
Soon enough, a fat girl with a bloated body broke through the encirclement in an instant, pretending to be slippery and about to pounce at Qi Wuyan. This pounce would be terrible, and she would lose half her life if she wasn't crushed to death!
Qi Wuyan turned around neatly and elegantly avoided the fat girl's attack. Then he frowned slightly in annoyance, fluttered his sleeves, and pushed her back when she was about to fall down. Then she followed the force and returned three times. In this way, she inexplicably stood firm and regained her center of gravity, which made everyone marvel.
The fat girl couldn't believe it. She was stunned on the spot. She had no idea what happened just now. She originally wanted to take the opportunity to knock down Qi Wuyan and feast on him. How...how did it end up like this? "Wow haha... It's so exciting. The spin just now is comparable to the Hu Xuan dance, hahahaha... It's so interesting..."
Everyone in the village turned toward the woman who was laughing wildly at the door. When they saw a girl dressed as a man laughing uncontrollably, everyone suddenly took a breath. Some people had disgust on their faces, and more of them had fear on their faces, as if they would contract some terrible plague if they touched her.
"It's Liang Zhaoying from Liang Sheng Liang Company!"
Qi Wuyan's originally impatient eyes suddenly lit up, and he quickly looked towards the door, his attitude obviously changing.
He didn't even bother to deal with other women, but Zhaoying was different from other women. She had a special place in his heart, and his attention to her was certainly unusual.
Speaking of Liang Zhaoying, like Qi Wuyan, everyone in the capital knows it, but the reason why she impresses everyone is not her appearance, but her somewhat crazy words and deeds.
Everyone is rumoring that she must have been possessed by some evil spirit, so that her temperament suddenly changed after the death of her brother Liang Zhaoxu three years ago, and she became neither a man nor a woman. Therefore, no one wanted to propose marriage to the Liang family and marry her, and she was already past the marriageable age.She is a twenty-one year old girl.
However, she didn't want to pay attention to the gossip about her from the outside world. She dressed up as a man and took over the business of Liang Sheng Grain Store from her mother. She no longer regarded herself as a woman.
As soon as Liang Zhaoying walked into the cloth shop, the girls closest to her hurriedly stepped aside and made way out of the way very proactively. They didn't want to have any contact with her, for fear that they would get the same crazy disease as her. And Liang Zhaoying had long been accustomed to the attitude of women avoiding her as a plague, so it didn't hurt at all.
